remediation.name: storefront
remediation.required_value: an image reference that actually exists in the registry and provides the sh/nc shell the container command needs (e.g. busybox:1.36); the tag registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1 does not resolve

arguments.root_cause_statement: The Deployment web/storefront was rolled out with a container image reference that does not exist. Its pod template names registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1, and every pull attempt on the node fails with a NotFound from the registry ("failed to resolve reference ... not found"). The ReplicaSet storefront-68b686c56f creates both pods and the scheduler places them successfully on incident-lab-control-plane, but the kubelet can never start the storefront container, so both pods stay Pending with ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff and the Deployment reports 0/2 available (Available=False, MinimumReplicasUnavailable). Nothing about identity, config, storage or node capacity is involved: the pods are scheduled and the failure is purely image resolution. Fixing the incident requires editing the Deployment's pod template image to a tag that exists in the registry; the pods themselves are disposable and will be recreated by the ReplicaSet.
arguments.mechanism: The Deployment web/storefront sets .spec.template.spec.containers[storefront].image to "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1", a tag the registry does not have, so the kubelet's pull fails with "failed to resolve reference ... not found" and the container is held in ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff on both replicas; the Deployment stays at 0/2 available with Available=False / MinimumReplicasUnavailable while the kubelet keeps re-attempting the pull under back-off.

evidence.claim: Both storefront pods are Pending and stuck waiting on the image pull.
The Deployment reports no available replicas.
evidence.quote: Replicas:               2 desired | 2 updated | 2 total | 0 available | 2 unavailable

evidence.claim: The Deployment pod template names the non-resolvable image tag.
The kubelet cannot resolve that image reference in the registry.
evidence.quote: Failed to pull image "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1": rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1": failed to resolve reference "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1": registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1: not found

evidence.claim: The same NotFound pull failure affects both replicas, not just one pod.
evidence.quote: web Warning Failed pod/storefront-68b686c56f-c7tvt x1 Failed to pull image "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1": rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1": failed to resolve reference

ruled_out.alternative: Pods are Pending because the scheduler could not place them (node capacity, taints, node pressure).
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The pod is already scheduled and bound to the node; Pending is due to the container image, not scheduling.
ruled_out.quote: Normal   Scheduled  16s               default-scheduler  Successfully assigned web/storefront-68b686c56f-d4pp7 to incident-lab-control-plane

ruled_out.alternative: Missing or wrong registry credentials (imagePullSecrets) blocking the pull.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The registry answered with NotFound on reference resolution, not an authentication/authorization error, so credentials are not the blocker.
ruled_out.quote: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1": failed to resolve reference

ruled_out.alternative: A missing ConfigMap, Secret or volume reference is keeping the container from starting.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The pod template mounts nothing and sets no environment references; the only volume is the default projected service-account token.

ruled_out.alternative: The node itself is unhealthy or out of resources.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The only node is Ready with full allocatable capacity and no taints listed.
